name: 48144-decode-gptoss120b-8gpu
model: openai/gpt-oss-120b, a 128-expert MXFP4 mixture-of-experts checkpoint; ~61 GB on disk and NOT in the local HF cache, so the first run pays the download.
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, one whole a3 node (--gres=gpu:8), driver 570.195.03, nothing else on the card.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1, expert parallelism ON, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams = 256, warmup 20%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 5120 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, leaving ~3584 scored. Expect tens of seconds of traffic plus model load.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, FIXED 128 prompt tokens / 128 output tokens (min = max = nominal on both), `request_format: plain` so no chat template is applied, `temperature: 0.0`.
purpose: A 120-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts chat assistant giving short fixed-length replies to 256 concurrent users across eight GPUs.
launch:
# vLLM 0.23.1rc0-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add keys from a later vLLM. Every key below is written out rather than inherited from the
# engine or the checkpoint, and none may be swept.
model: openai/gpt-oss-120b
tensor-parallel-size: 8
enable-expert-parallel: true
moe-backend: marlin
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 2048

# PINNED: an in-process engine build falls through to the SchedulerConfig defaults (2048 / 128),
# and 128 is below the 256 concurrent streams this setup declares.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: true
